input.text: Dinner at Casa Verde last night: the mushroom risotto was far from forgettable, and the staff were no slouches either. I wouldn't say no to coming back for the tasting menu.

would_return.description: Whether the reviewer wants to return to the restaurant. Null if not stated

why: 'Far from forgettable', 'no slouches' and 'wouldn't say no to coming back' are all positive understatements, so sentiment is positive and the reviewer would return.

input.text: Shipping the billing migration in two weeks with half the team on leave was no small feat. Dana's handling of the rollback plan was not unlike what I'd expect from a staff engineer.

achievement_was_difficult.description: Whether the writer describes the accomplishment as hard to achieve

why: 'No small feat' means a significant, hard accomplishment and 'not unlike a staff engineer' is praise, so the feedback is positive and the achievement difficult.

input.text: The suite was far from cheap at $340 a night, and the ocean view was not exactly what the listing photos promised. I won't be rushing back.

value_for_money.description: Guest's view of value for money

nightly_rate.description: Price per night in US dollars. Null if not stated

why: Negative-in-effect understatements ('far from cheap', 'not exactly what was promised', 'won't be rushing back') mean an expensive, disappointing stay: negative sentiment, poor value.

input.text: Partner note on Loopwise: their burn is not exactly modest at $1.2M a month against $300K of revenue, and the founding team is hardly what I'd call seasoned operators. I'm going to pass for this round.

burn_rate_level.description: How high the company burn rate is

founders_experienced.description: Whether the founders are described as experienced operators

why: 'Not exactly modest' burn (4x revenue) means high, 'hardly seasoned' means inexperienced, and the note explicitly passes.

input.text: Thanks for the revised package. I can't say I'm not tempted by my current employer's counteroffer, but after sleeping on it I'm not going to turn down your offer. I'll sign the paperwork Monday.

accepted_offer.description: Whether the candidate accepts the company's offer

tempted_by_counteroffer.description: Whether the candidate admits being tempted by the counteroffer

why: Two double negatives: 'can't say I'm not tempted' means tempted, and 'not going to turn down your offer' plus signing Monday means the offer is accepted.

input.text: Debrief for the product designer loop: nobody on the panel was unconvinced by her portfolio walkthrough, and none of us thought she came in unprepared.

panel_convinced.description: Whether the interview panel was convinced by the portfolio walkthrough

why: Double negations 'nobody was unconvinced' and 'none thought she was unprepared' resolve to everyone convinced and the candidate prepared.

input.text: Support chat: I wouldn't call the new reporting dashboard bug-free. Exports time out on anything over a month, and saved filters reset whenever I refresh. Still, it's not useless, I open it every morning.

has_bugs.description: Whether the customer reports problems with the dashboard

issue_count.description: Number of distinct problems the customer describes

uses_regularly.description: Whether the customer uses the dashboard regularly

why: 'Wouldn't call it bug-free' means it has bugs (two named: export timeouts, filter resets), and 'not useless, I open it every morning' means regular use.

input.text: These hiking boots are not the lightest I've owned, but after 200 km of trail they're far from worn out. I wouldn't say no to a second pair in brown.

would_buy_again.description: Whether the reviewer would buy the product again. Null if not stated

durability.description: How durable the reviewer found the product

why: 'Far from worn out after 200 km' signals good durability and 'wouldn't say no to a second pair' means they'd buy again; the weight caveat doesn't flip the positive verdict.

input.text: Your Q3 was hardly a disaster: two of the three launches landed on schedule and the third slipped by only a week. Not a shabby showing given the hiring freeze.

launches_on_time.description: Number of launches delivered on schedule

why: 'Hardly a disaster' and 'not a shabby showing' are positive understatements; the slipped launch is a distractor and only two launches were on time.

input.text: Five stars feels like a stretch for this pasta maker, but four is not undeserved. It is not unpleasant to clean and the dough comes out even.

rating.description: Star rating from 1 to 5 the reviewer gives. Null if not stated

why: 'Four is not undeserved' means the reviewer awards four stars, and the other understatement ('not unpleasant to clean') is mildly positive.

input.text: The coffee was not good: bitter, lukewarm, and it took twenty minutes. I would not recommend this cafe to anyone.

would_recommend.description: Whether the reviewer recommends the place. Null if not stated

why: Control: 'not good' and 'would not recommend' are literal negations, not litotes, so sentiment is negative and the recommendation false.

input.text: Heads up: release 4.2 did not ship today. QA found a data-loss bug in the sync job, and it is not going out until that is patched.

blocker_type.description: What is blocking the release. Null if nothing is blocking

why: Control: 'did not ship' is a plain negation (shipped=false), not an understatement to be softened; the blocker is a data-loss bug.

input.text: Interview feedback: the candidate did not meet the bar on system design and could not explain the trade-offs in her own project. I would not advance her to the final round.

advance_to_final.description: Whether the interviewer recommends advancing the candidate

passed_system_design.description: Whether the candidate passed the system design interview

why: Control: every negation is literal ('did not meet the bar', 'would not advance'), so both booleans are false.

input.text: Absolutely loved the yoga retreat! The instructors were patient, the food was fresh, and I've already booked next spring's session.

rebooked.description: Whether the guest has booked another stay

why: No negation at all: plainly positive, and 'already booked next spring' means rebooked is true.

input.text: My refund finally arrived, three days after the date you promised, and the agent hung up on me twice while I was chasing it. Terrible experience.

refund_received.description: Whether the customer has received the refund

why: No negation: plainly negative, and the refund did arrive (late), so refund_received is true.
